summary: Swept official sources and the press for developments since 2026-10-13 and deep-checked 41 tracked records chosen by oldest last check and lowest confidence, including 16 counted as in effect that received a refutation check. No stage changed. Two progress figures moved: c19-05 (automated vehicles) from 35 to 40 after NHTSA's 2026-07-31 Zoox deployment exemption, and c18-06 (ESG in ERISA investing) from 12 to 15 after the draft rule reached White House review on 2026-06-30. Twenty-two records gained evidence or corrections and went to independent review, among them the FY2027 refugee determination of 17,500 (c06-04), the primary 2025-02-05 Attorney General memorandum (c17-02), the OFCCP rescission rule effective 2026-10-26 (c18-01), the Bureau of Prisons contract injunction and First Circuit stay in the union cases (c03-02), confirmation of P.L. 119-60 as the FY2026 NDAA with the pit production section (c12-10), three NRC rulemakings (c12-06), the Gulf lease sale 4 notice (c16-01) and corrected court statuses on five records. Seven in-effect records held under refutation checks with only red-team findings recorded, and 12 records were checked without change, four of them with documented systematic absence checks. A reported Justice Department appeal of the 2026-10-13 press access injunction (c01-01) could not be confirmed from a readable source and is recorded as an uncertainty. No requests were pending; the three pending leads remain blocked documents. During the GitHub export, run at the owner's direction, the repository validator rejected nine records, which were brought into schema conformance without any change of substance: month-only timeline dates in c06-25, c06-26, c11-23, c11-24, c11-34, c12-34, c13-02 and c22-07 were set to the first of the month with a month-only note, and c05-25 gained its FY2027 budget request event from the CRS analysis already cited. The export branch was prepared and validated, but the push was refused because the repository is not attached to the session.
